topline.text: A new "Stop School Cuts" report from ASCL, NEU and NAHT finds schools are £4.5bn worse off in real terms than in 2010 — nearly three-quarters of schools down on per-pupil funding, with £300m lost in the last year alone.
topline.action: Useful sector-wide context if you're making the case locally for protecting inclusion spend against wider budget pressure.

topline.text: The NEU has confirmed a formal strike ballot of teachers in England will run 3 October–15 December over pay and funding, after its executive stopped short of also balloting support staff.
topline.action: Worth an early heads-up to SLT — a December ballot result could mean action landing in the new year.

diary.text: DfE EOTAS (education otherwise than at school) consultation closes.
Rotherham Schools Forum meets — agenda includes the exclusion & suspensions annual report and an EHCP update.
NEU formal strike ballot of teachers opens in England (closes 15 Dec).

items.lede: Unions warn schools are £4.5bn worse off since 2010.
items.body: The Stop School Cuts coalition (ASCL, NEU, NAHT) published new real-terms analysis this week showing nearly three-quarters of schools have less per-pupil funding than in 2010, with over 3,700 schools down more than £1,000 per pupil and schools losing £300m in the last year alone.
items.action: Sector-wide figures worth citing if you're pressing for inclusion funding to be protected in any in-year budget conversation.

items.lede: NEU confirms formal strike ballot timetable.
items.body: The union's national executive confirmed a formal ballot of the 280,000+ teachers it represents in England will run 3 October to 15 December over pay and funding, after an earlier indicative ballot saw over 90% of participating teachers say they'd be willing to take action; a parallel ballot of support staff was not agreed by the executive.
items.action: A result in mid-December would land right before spring-term planning — worth flagging to SLT now.

box.quote: It's a quieter few days on the national wires — a good window to get ahead of the EOTAS consultation before it closes 18 September.
